Río Real Playa tiene acceso directo a la playa, dos piscinas exteriores, una de ellas climatizada con edificios de 6 apartamentos. descripcion.en: In the exclusive residential complex of Río Real Playa. One of the few apartments available in Marbella directly on the beach and ready to move into, spacious 3-bedroom house, spacious living-dining room open to the terrace with panoramic views over the Mediterranean, en-suite bathrooms with heated floors and service toilet, fully equipped kitchen with utility room. Río Real Playa has direct access to the beach, two outdoor swimming pools, one of them heated with 6-apartment buildings. The ideal setting to enjoy the sunset with the sea in the background with family or friends, next to the famous Trocadero Arena restaurant, a few minutes from the Río Real, Sta.
